corrections.correction_title: Correction: Deep-learning-based gas identification by time-variant illumination of a single micro-LED-embedded gas sensor
corrections.assessment: Publisher correction to the cited article; the article is not retracted and remains citable. This Review cites it only for the general point that raw optical/temporal signal structure can carry information that hand-engineered descriptors discard, and for its reporting of an illumination protocol. The correction does not bear on either use.
